{{Quote|I could use a brisk walk, Master Jun-Fan. I don't think I've ever been this cold.|[[Tatsu]], to [[Bruu Jun-Fan]]|<ref name="TSH" />}}
'''Orto Norwe'''<ref name="Email" /> was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="FF23" /> located in the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to a settlement known as [[Yellowblade's Landing]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] landed there shortly after [[Skirmish above Raydonia/Legends|leaving]] [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]].<ref name="TSH" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[March]] [[2023]] that Yellowblade's Landing was a location on Orto Norwe, thus meaning that the [[Orto Norwe system/Legends|Orto Norwe system]] was created to provide a name for the ice world featured in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''.<ref name="Email" />
